chunks: He said: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Two units of prayer performed by a married person are better than an unmarried man who spends his nights in prayer and his days fasting."

key_terms.يَقُومُ: stands in worship, especially at night

ai.seo_question: Why are two rak'ahs prayed by a married person considered better than the worship of an unmarried man?
ai.summary: This hadith states the superiority of the worship of a married person in comparison to the intense devotional practice of an unmarried man. It highlights the virtue and religious significance of marriage alongside acts of worship such as salat (prayer) and sawm (fasting).
